h: Sanwo-Olu refuses to pick between Wizkid and Davido
p: Lagos Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu declined to choose between Wizkid and Davido in a rapid-fire interview, simply answering 'None'. He also avoided picking between Ayra Starr and Tiwa Savage.
body: Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu has stayed out of one of Nigerian music's biggest rivalries, refusing to choose between Wizkid and Davido.
In a clip from a rapid-fire interview circulating on social media, the governor was asked to pick his favourite of the two Afrobeats stars. Instead of choosing, he simply replied, "None."
He was also asked to choose between Ayra Starr and Tiwa Savage, and again declined to pick one over the other.
The clip circulated on the day Davido marked his 34th birthday.
